assets.subject: Single flat amber-gold light wave, no twist — represents ordinary color-only light perception
assets.matte_method_note: Chroma-green attempted first (Step 3 method 2) but caused visible green color-spill contamination on this translucent/glowing subject (amber read as yellow-green) — regenerated on near-black instead, confirmed clean. See Motion-Graphics-Compositing SKILL.md's 2026-08-21 finding: chroma-green is unreliable for translucent/glowing components, use near-black for those specifically.
